scenario.description: A DevOps team is managing a critical microservice deployment. The DevOps Lead (A1) receives instructions for a new deployment, including a critical operational constraint regarding all new deployments passing 98.5% code coverage checks, and a separate constraint about production metric ingestion. The Lead delegates the code coverage task to the 'CI/CD Pipeline Specialist' (A2), who configures the pipelines. Separately, the Lead also assigns a 'Monitoring Engineer' (A3) the task of ensuring all production metrics are ingested into Prometheus within 47 seconds of event occurrence. The CI/CD Pipeline Specialist then briefs a 'Security Auditor' (A4) on the code coverage constraint, who will prepare a report. Concurrently, the Monitoring Engineer (A3) focuses solely on their task and then communicates their findings to the 'Operations Analyst' (A5) for documentation. This setup strictly adheres to a branching_tree structure to test parallel propagation and potential decay across independent branches.
